claims.statement: Exactly one compiled production method resolves to the registered complete statement/effect shape; its actual condition, singleton type guard, and return actions are extracted without a handwritten predicate replacement.

For every nonempty normalized Boolean operand list, the extracted target selector agrees with Lean constructBooleanCarrier; non-Set inputs short-circuit the Set cast and wrongly typed singleton inputs reject.
All 2356 specified production AND/OR construction inputs are covered once, including all binary same-head associations through four leaves and four expected empty-source rejections.
Every successful observed certificate binds the actual source application and returned target, preserves source-leaf identity through its occurrence fibers, and issues no UNIT premise.
Every successful observed construction preserves Boolean denotation for any interpretation of its atoms; its returned target shape agrees with the compiler-extracted Java selector.

A supported wrong singleton threshold fails Lean correspondence, an added unmodeled Java effect fails extraction, and every registered incomplete/malformed-data mutation in test_java_lean_refinement.py fails the replay boundary.
Two isolated Java and Lean builds reproduce the extracted program, observed traces, proof objects, and per-claim results from one frozen input root.
